usedHookFrames: concrete evidence before naming passion problem
control request tested through visible support
mission made concrete through a public artifact
usedTryThisNowFrames: so-good-they-cant-ignore-you-ch01: Pick one career story you admire and mark one sentence as inspiration and one sentence as actual evidence you could use today.
so-good-they-cant-ignore-you-ch02: Write one interest, then add the exact paid role, skill, buyer, or institution it would need before becoming career evidence.
so-good-they-cant-ignore-you-ch03: Take one mismatch feeling and classify it as bad environment, beginner friction, weak skill, or untested preference.
so-good-they-cant-ignore-you-ch04: For one task today, replace Do I like this? with What would make this output more useful to the next person?
so-good-they-cant-ignore-you-ch05: Name one work trait you want, then write the rare skill or output someone would trade for it.
so-good-they-cant-ignore-you-ch06: Choose one desired reward and write the next three compounding proofs that should come before you ask for it.
so-good-they-cant-ignore-you-ch07: Pick one weekly task and define the measurable flaw you will practice against next time.
so-good-they-cant-ignore-you-ch08: Write one kind of control you want and the proof of value that would make it easier for others to accept.
so-good-they-cant-ignore-you-ch09: For one resisted request, write what value the other side is afraid of losing and what evidence shows your move still works.
so-good-they-cant-ignore-you-ch10: Before one autonomy leap, list the support under it: paying demand, repeatable skill, runway, and fallback evidence.
so-good-they-cant-ignore-you-ch11: Draw two columns for one control move: value someone may resist losing, and support that lets the move survive without them.
so-good-they-cant-ignore-you-ch12: Name one freedom you have earned and finish this sentence: This freedom should now help me move toward...
so-good-they-cant-ignore-you-ch13: Write a mission idea you like, then list the specific skill frontier you are close enough to understand.
so-good-they-cant-ignore-you-ch14: Turn one mission idea into a seven-day bet with a visible output, one audience, and one feedback signal.
so-good-they-cant-ignore-you-ch15: Write the smallest public artifact your mission needs next: a demo, memo, field note, talk, page, or invitation to one real audience.
so-good-they-cant-ignore-you-ch16: Choose one live career decision and label which step it really needs next: evidence, capital, control, or mission visibility.
